purpose: Two proposed production-rule slides. Key poses are illustrative, not a validated animation rig.
motionInitial: Create a four-panel animation key-pose study strip for the Airtap hand mascot. Wide 3:1 landscape, exactly FOUR separate full characters in a single evenly spaced row, no panel borders or text. Input1 is authoritative identity and front/side/back shape: THREE upright rounded finger lobes plus ONE side thumb, cream soft broad palm, tiny black vertical capsule eyes and small rose-pink nose on PALM ONLY, no mouth; shallow FOUR-POINT star on BACK ONLY. Input2 is STYLE ONLY, minimal single contour lines; do NOT copy its smiles. Use clean dark-gray simple thin line drawings, rose nose as tiny flat pink circle, back star outlined gray, no hatching, no shading, no gradients, no shadows, no paper texture. Transparent exterior AND body interiors so #FAF9F6 slide background shows through. Four key poses from LEFT to RIGHT: 1 RECEIVE: front palm toward camera, thumb on viewer RIGHT, three fingers up, face visible. 2 TURN: same hand rotates 90 degrees to a narrow SIDE PROFILE, fingers still up, nose only a small profile bump, same volume. 3 TAP: same hand rotated to a rear three-quarter view and tilted downward, BACK surface and four-point star clearly visible, NO FACE. The INDEX finger immediately adjacent to its thumb extends down and touches a small simple muted green target ellipse below. Other TWO fingers curl naturally toward palm as soft lobes; thumb stays distinct on the viewer LEFT of this rear view, total exactly four digits. NO extra wrist, arm, legs or fingertips. Contact point at the tip of the index, not middle finger, not whole palm. Show this pose as one continuous hand object. 4 RETURN: restore same front palm view as frame1, thumb on viewer RIGHT, small attentive eyes and rose nose visible, no mouth. Same camera and scale throughout, complete silhouettes, generous spacing. This demonstrates a physical rotation and action, NOT a magical swapping face, NOT two different hands. No text, labels, arrows, screens, phones, watermark or scenery.
motionCorrection: Edit reference1 four-frame line-art strip. Keep frames1,2,4 identical. REPLACE ONLY frame3 because its current anatomy is WRONG (five digits and fingers on two opposite edges). Frame3 must be a simple rear-view TAPPING FOUR-DIGIT HAND. Use reference2 ONLY for downward-tap anatomy, NOT rendering style or background. Draw a rounded hand body at upper part of frame3, no wrist or arm, four-point star on back. ALL finger tips face DOWN, NONE point UP: exactly TWO short curled finger lobes at lower LEFT edge, ONE longer index finger extends downward from lower RIGHT and touches small green ellipse, ONE short thumb lobe at RIGHT outer edge beside the index. Total four digits. This is reference1's same hand pitched forward and turned palm-down; rear face toward viewer, no eyes/nose/mouth. Smooth continuous rounded perimeter with one elongated lower-right index and two tucked lower-left fingers, thumb only one right side. No three upright fingers above the palm: top edge is a plain rounded palm base. Keep simplified gray outline, NO shading or texture. Transparent background, warmwhite interiors matching #FAF9F6, no shadows or ground. Preserve spacing and all other frames. No typography, screens, arrows or extra imagery.
handedness: Create a two-character comparison line-art sheet on transparent background, landscape2:1. Input1 is authoritative Airtap character front form, use ONLY front view shape. LEFT character is current standard: palm facing viewer and thumb on viewer RIGHT. RIGHT character is mirrored anatomical counterpart: palm facing viewer and thumb on viewer LEFT. Both are PALM FRONT, both have eyes/nose, NO back stars. Completely same camera, scale and baseline, no tilt. Simple thin charcoal-gray contour linework with no hatching, no shading, no gradients, no cast shadows, no groundlines, no textures. Transparent body interiors AND exterior to reveal warmwhite slide background #FAF9F6. Nose only a small rose colored dot. No text labels, arrows, frames, watermark, props, wrists, arms or legs.
